parsed_response.rationale:
The current low-level goals (LLGs) comprehensively cover the parent high-level goal (HLG) of 'Ensure transparent and traceable product sourcing'. Each LLG is directly related to a specific aspect of the customer's interaction with the system, from viewing product details to managing order modifications and cancellations. The descriptions are clear and aligned with the provided project description. No essential capabilities are missing, and there is no redundancy or misleading information.

The LLGs 'View product origin details' (llg_001), 'Browse and compare farmer offers' (llg_002), and 'Place an order for selected products' (llg_003) directly support the customer's ability to make informed purchasing decisions. The LLGs 'Modify order due to availability constraints' (llg_004), 'Review and accept modified order' (llg_005), and 'Cancel order due to complete unavailability' (llg_006) address the dynamic nature of product availability and the customer's ability to manage their orders accordingly.

The reconstructed HLG' accurately summarizes the parent HLG, focusing on the customer's role in transparent and traceable product sourcing. The LLGs provided are complete and correctly realize this HLG'. There is no need for regeneration or correction.
